questions.prompt: Which feature defines Von Neumann architecture?
options: Shared memory for instructions and data

mistakes.misconception: Confuses Von Neumann with Harvard architecture — separate buses is the Harvard design.
mistakes.correction: Von Neumann uses one shared memory and a single bus for both instructions and data.

mistakes.misconception: Attributes Harvard cache organisation to Von Neumann.
mistakes.correction: Cache hierarchy is orthogonal to the basic stored-program model; Von Neumann says nothing about caches.
